$description: The JavaScript allowed under platform/ (docs/adr/0011, closing addendum; #61, #781). Every other .js/.jsx source is TypeScript. check-system's js-source rule fails on a .js/.jsx under platform/ that is in neither list (platform/design-system, vendor, dist and mobile are outside the rule: the spec site and copies). `allowed` is permanent, each with its reason. `pending` was what was still to convert; it is empty since every wave finished (#61, #57), so any new .js/.jsx outside `allowed` fails. A conversion does not edit this file (parallel PRs would conflict); the DS Architect prunes converted entries.

allowed.platform/dev/: page scripts loaded by a plain <script> with no bundle (#818 rulings)
allowed.platform/providers/theme-boot.js: copied verbatim to the CDN and the styles package, runs in <head> before React; size-scale reads its markers
allowed.platform/loader/loader.js: the <script> that loads the bundle, so it cannot be inside it
allowed.platform/engines/plenix-engines.js: copied verbatim to dist/ and the CDN (build-packages.js)
allowed.platform/icons/layout.js: required as CommonJS by Node build tools with no TypeScript loader
allowed.platform/icons/uses.js: required as CommonJS by Node build tools with no TypeScript loader
allowed.platform/i18n/en.js: the English catalog, read by path by the locale checks and tests
allowed.platform/i18n/ar.js: the Arabic catalog, read by path by the locale checks; protected (D-0012)
allowed.platform/loader/plenix-loader.js: copied verbatim to the CDN beside plenix.js and loaded by a plain <script> before any module (ADR 0052, #1208): it writes the import map, so it cannot be a module itself; same kind as theme-boot.js
